summary: American Rebel Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K regarding entry into a material definitive agreement—a $155,294.12 promissory note with Quick Capital LLC. Net proceeds of $132,000 reflect a $23,294.12 original issue discount and $7,000 legal fees. The note bears 18.75% guaranteed interest, payable in fifteen monthly installments starting July 2026. Upon default, a 150% penalty applies; the lender can convert to common stock at 75% of the lowest 5-day trading price. No warrants are attached. Proceeds fund working capital. This is not a special situation—it is a routine debt financing with convertible features, lacking acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event elements.
